membership_window.authority: Accepted exact dated BaoStock rosters define required-scope membership for every observed session in the window.

provider_fact_policy: Preserve provider ipoDate/outDate as immutable source facts. Do not infer uniform membership inclusivity from provider outDate.

boundary_policy.present_on_provider_outdate: normalized_effective_to equals provider_out_date; inclusive last confirmed membership session.
boundary_policy.absent_on_provider_outdate: normalized_effective_to equals the last dated-roster membership session before provider_out_date only if no reappearance is observed through the roster window end.
boundary_policy.unresolved: Fail closed for missing prior membership, post-outDate reappearance, or missing provider lifecycle fact.

revision_policy: Append-only. New revisions supersede current revisions; UPDATE and DELETE are prohibited.
lineage_policy: Bind accepted roster SHA-256, R6.1 all-day coverage SHA-256, raw provider lifecycle facts SHA-256, resolver script SHA-256, and normalized interval artifact SHA-256.
